scope: Visible storefront UI only; merchant claims are not independently verified.

claims.claim: Official Palo Alto:Dynamo listing iframe resolves to this technical-bags storefront. Rendered home has repeated 10%-off/US$250 free-shipping announcement, shop/about/sale/FAQ/blog navigation, countdown hero, Best Sellers/Tech Accessories tabbed shelf, product Quick Buy cards, mosaics, material/organization editorial, featured products, newsletter and trust row. Footer states demo goods are provided by AER; merchant product and durability claims are unverified.

Best Sellers - AER collection reports 12 products and category shortcuts; visible sorting offers Featured/relevance/best-selling/alphabetical/price/date choices, with Availability/Price/Color/Product Type facets. Product cards show prices, color counts, Quick Buy and badges; no control used.

Navigator Backpack PDP has a 20-entry gallery, in-stock label, $268 versus $400 sale pricing, 33% discount, Black/Grey options, quantity and purchase controls, lifetime-guarantee and repair-kit copy, limited-time offer, materials/specs and shipping accordions, product FAQs, nylon editorial, related collection mosaics and recently-viewed module. Seller and stock claims unverified.

Dedicated cart is empty and links to Small Bags, Work Bags and all products; displays US$250 free-shipping threshold and trust claims for free shipping/returns, lifetime guarantee and recycled materials.
